title: REQ · art:generate script writes PNGs and the manifest, and is wired as an npm script
summary: runGenerateArt with injected IO, a vite-node script and an npm script
description: Context: package.json has no generator command. Desired behavior: runGenerateArt(deps) generates assets, writes each PNG under the assets root and rewrites the manifest JSON with two-space indent and trailing newline; scripts/generateArt.ts wires node:fs; package.json gets art:generate. Why: this is the real entry point that reaches the new code.
acceptance_criteria: Given fake IO, when runGenerateArt runs twice, then the written bytes of each file are equal
Given fake IO, when it runs, then the manifest written parses and holds an entry per source
Given package.json, when read, then scripts.art:generate equals vite-node scripts/generateArt.ts
technical_constraints: Assets root is game/frontend/public/assets; manifest is game/public/assets/worlds/the-boys-room/manifest.json
No CDN or image service; deterministic output
definition_of_done: npm run art:generate works from game/frontend
